name: Makkari (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Makkari village emblem in yellow: an interlaced six-pointed star.
history: Municipal flag of Makkari, a village in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 23 December 1967.

features.role: Makkari village emblem — an interlaced six-pointed star
